mentions.name: Dirac
mentions.description: An AI-native, decision-based email app designed to save users time, positioning itself as the opposite of traditional email apps built to keep users engaged inside them. Launching on Product Hunt.
mentions.problem: Current email apps are made for users to spend time within them, and existing 'AI email apps' end up making the user their own assistant instead of saving them time.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I build https://dirac.app , a decision-based, ai-native email app.

evidence.value: So I build https://dirac.app , a decision-based, ai-native email app.
